originalTitle: What Is Behind The Move In Robinhood Stock?

Shares of Robinhood Markets (HOOD) dropped 7.2% on Friday, October 30, 2026, while the S&P 500 fell 1.8%. The company released no announcements, earnings reports or filings that day or the day before. A news report tied the fall to a slide in cryptocurrencies after Binance disclosed the largest crypto hack on record. That link is not obvious for a stock that sits in the financial sector. So where does crypto show up in Robinhood’s business?

Where Crypto Shows Up In Robinhood’s Business

Crypto shows up in the trading Robinhood offers and in a blockchain of its own. Customers trade crypto on Robinhood alongside stocks and options, and a Friday news report said crypto is a meaningful part of the company’s revenue. During its October 27 call for the third quarter, management said Robinhood’s market share grew by double digits from a year earlier in equities, options, crypto and margin.

The new blockchain is called Robinhood Chain. Management said that during the chain’s first quarter, it handled $100 billion in decentralized exchange trading and earned over $50 million in fees.

Did Robinhood Fall Alone On Friday?

No. Every company on Robinhood’s peer list closed lower : Charles Schwab, Interactive Brokers, Coinbase Global, SoFi Technologies and Morgan Stanley. Coinbase Global dropped 10.6%, a steeper fall than Robinhood’s, and Interactive Brokers lost 6.0%. The other three companies fell by less.

Financial stocks as a whole held up far better, with the SPDR fund for the financial sector (XLF) losing 0.8%. The wider market slid too. News reports said disappointing results from Amazon and Intel set off more selling of artificial-intelligence stocks. Robinhood’s drop sat much closer to those of Coinbase Global and Interactive Brokers than to the financial sector’s.

How Robinhood Stock Has Done Over Twelve Months

Falls this large are not rare for Robinhood. The stock dropped at least this much on 13 sessions in the prior 365 days. The latest was October 14, when it lost 8.5%.

The past year has been hard on holders. Robinhood stock lost 41.3% over the twelve months to October 30, while the S&P 500 returned 11.3%. Friday’s close of $84.99 sits far below the stock’s highest close of those twelve months, which was $147.08 on November 3, 2025. Its lowest close came on March 30, 2026, at $65.16. The shares are still up 15.4% since May 1, but they lost 23.5% from October 1 to October 30, against a 1.1% fall for the S&P 500.

The stock still trades at 15.0 times Robinhood’s sales of the past twelve months, against 3.2 times for the S&P 500. When Robinhood reports its fiscal Q4 2026 results, expected in February 2027, look at how fast revenue grew from a year earlier, after 11.8% in fiscal Q3 2026.

Now you know Robinhood Markets better. Our purpose is to inform you so you can decide for yourself, and acting on one stock, in either direction, carries its own risk.

Robinhood Markets (HOOD) 的股价于 2026 年 10 月 30 日星期五下跌 7.2%，而标准普尔 500 指数下跌 1.8%。该公司当天或前一天没有发布任何公告、收益报告或文件。在币安披露了有记录以来最大的加密货币黑客攻击事件后，一份新闻报道将此次下跌与加密货币的下滑联系起来。对于金融行业的股票来说，这种联系并不明显。那么加密货币在 Robinhood 的业务中体现在哪里呢？

加密货币在 Robinhood 的业务中出现的地方

加密货币出现在 Robinhood 的交易产品及其自己的区块链中。客户在 Robinhood 上交易加密货币以及股票和期权，周五的新闻报道称加密货币是该公司收入的重要组成部分。在 10 月 27 日的第三季度电话会议上，管理层表示，Robinhood 在股票、期权、加密货币和保证金方面的市场份额较上年同期增长了两位数。

新的区块链称为 Robinhood Chain。管理层表示，该链第一季度处理了 1000 亿美元的去中心化交易所交易，赚取了超过 5000 万美元的费用。

周五罗宾汉独自堕落了吗？

Robinhood 同行名单上的每家公司均收盘下跌：嘉信理财 (Charles Schwab)、盈透证券 (Interactive Brokers)、Coinbase Global、SoFi Technologies 和摩根士丹利 (Morgan Stanley)。 Coinbase Global 下跌 10.6%，跌幅超过 Robinhood，Interactive Brokers 下跌 6.0%。其他三家公司跌幅较小。

金融股整体表现要好得多，金融板块 SPDR 基金 (XLF) 下跌 0.8%。大盘也出现下滑。新闻报道称，亚马逊和英特尔令人失望的业绩引发了更多人工智能股票的抛售。 Robinhood 的跌幅与 Coinbase Global 和 Interactive Brokers 的跌幅要接近得多，而不是金融行业的跌幅。

Robinhood 股票十二个月以来的表现如何

对于罗宾汉来说，如此大的跌倒并不罕见。在过去 365 天里，该股有 13 个交易日至少下跌了这么多。最近一次是10月14日，当时下跌了8.5%。

过去的一年对持有者来说是艰难的一年。截至 10 月 30 日的 12 个月内，Robinhood 股价下跌 41.3%，而标准普尔 500 指数则上涨 11.3%。周五收盘价为 84.99 美元，远低于该股过去 12 个月的最高收盘价（2025 年 11 月 3 日的 147.08 美元）。其最低收盘价为 2026 年 3 月 30 日的 65.16 美元。自5月1日以来，该股仍上涨15.4%，但从10月1日至10月30日下跌23.5%，而标准普尔500指数则下跌1.1%。

该股的交易价格仍是 Robinhood 过去 12 个月销售额的 15.0 倍，而标准普尔 500 指数的市盈率是 3.2 倍。当 Robinhood 预计于 2027 年 2 月公布 2026 年第四财季业绩时，看看收入较上年同期增长有多快，2026 年第三财季增长了 11.8%。
